facts.text: I never did time, but I can cook. Thirty days of prison food starts tonight, James, so eat your plain rice.
facts.why: Darnell pretends to have been inside until Gayle exposes him late in the film. He never cooks in the training, which is fights, mock riots and a remodelled house. A note saying 'I never did time' gives away the twist.
facts.fix: Thirty days, James. I've been inside, so you do what I say. Start with plain rice.
